pieces.doc: Optional visual arrow inside `ForTooltipContent`. Registers itself with the tooltip context so floating-ui's `arrow` middleware can position it along the bubble edge that points at the trigger. Style size and color yourself — the directive only sets `position`, `left`/`top`, and the opposite-side offset.
The tooltip bubble. Carries `role="tooltip"`, is portaled to `document.body`, and is positioned by `@floating-ui/dom` (via the shared `injectOverlayShell` helper) while mounted.

Element that activates the tooltip on hover or focus. Apply on a focusable element — preferably a `<button>` so keyboard users can reach it. Receives `aria-describedby` only while the tooltip is open, per APG.

inputs.name: side
inputs.doc: Side the tooltip is anchored to. Defaults to `'top'`. Pair with `align` for the full positioning API.

inputs.name: align
inputs.doc: Alignment along the chosen `side`. Defaults to `'center'`.

inputs.name: sideOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) between trigger and content along the main axis. Default `8`. Mirrors Radix's `sideOffset`.

inputs.name: alignOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the cross axis (parallel to `side`). Default `0`.

inputs.name: avoidCollisions
inputs.doc: When `true` (default), `flip` and `shift` keep the tooltip inside the viewport. Disable for strict positioning where overflow is acceptable.

inputs.name: collisionPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) applied uniformly to the `flip`, `shift`, and `size` middlewares. Default `8`.

inputs.name: sticky
inputs.doc: Stickiness behaviour for `shift`. `'partial'` (default) lets the tooltip shift to stay visible. `'always'` keeps the requested placement even off-screen.

inputs.name: hideWhenDetached
inputs.doc: When `true`, sets `data-detached=""` while the trigger has scrolled off all clipping ancestors.

inputs.name: openDelay
inputs.doc: Per-tooltip override for the open delay (ms). When `undefined` (default), falls back to `ForTooltipDefaults.delayDuration` from the surrounding `provideForTooltipDefaults` scope (700ms unless configured).

inputs.name: closeDelay
inputs.doc: ms before the tooltip closes after hover or focus leaves. `Escape` ignores this. Default `300`.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, all hover / focus interaction is ignored and any open tooltip is forced closed.

models.name: open
models.doc: Two-way bindable. Whether the tooltip is currently shown. The `model()` change emitter (`(openChange)`) fires only on internal transitions (hover/focus delays, Escape), never on consumer writes via `[(open)]` — observe state changes without binding back.
